text:
The detective slammed his hand on the metal table, the sound echoing in the sterile interrogation room. "Cut the act," he growled, leaning in close, his eyes locked onto the suspect's shifting gaze. "Where were you the night of the crime?"

The suspect flinched, his hands trembling as he wiped sweat from his forehead. "I was home! All night, I swear on my life!" His voice cracked, betraying the panic he was trying to suppress.

The detective didn't blink, studying every micro-expression, searching for the slightest crack in the alibi. He needed the truth, and he wasn't leaving until he got it.

Name the shape with three sides.
